findings.message: Two available packet reference slots could include the stage-5 Alembic revision and users repository as additional execution context.
The program overview retains historical MinIO wording for stage 6 while this revision correctly specifies RustFS S3-compatible storage; refresh the overview separately.
Implementation must keep boto3 out of eager test collection and inject a fake storage adapter so deterministic tests remain independent of ambient dependency installation and live services.

evidenceQuality.summary: Repo-root validation commands are runnable, deterministic tests are separated from live Docker/RustFS/WebSocket checks, and unavailable live dependencies remain explicit.

implementationQuality.summary: Worker domain writes remain disjoint from the four runtime controller seams; the refreeze additionally declares only the frozen plan package and progress log controller-owned, matching the observed implementation delta. Authorization, pagination, idempotency and file-contract obligations remain executable.

requirementFit.summary: REQ-BE-CHAT maps to both acceptance criteria, evidence receipts, workstream ownership and final audit gates.

residualRisk.summary: No High or Medium findings remain; three Low follow-ups are advisory and do not block freeze.

summary: Independent read-only audit of revision 5 confirmed an ownership-only refreeze: the exact accepted origin/dev baseline, requirements, acceptance/evidence, DAG, worker write-set, budgets, gates, RustFS/no-MinIO scope and local-model exclusion are unchanged; the two new controller-owned paths match the implementation delta and no High or Medium blocker remains.
